name: Bronze Key
description: The first two keys on a character.

effects: Unlock $embedcolor <character>$#<color hex code> for the character.

name: Silver Key
description: Keys three through five on a character.

effects: Teal and Green Kakera on this character are replaced by Orange Kakera.

name: Gold Key
description: Keys six through nine on a character.

effects: Earn the character's Kakera value when rolling it, subject to the $bku cap.

name: Chaos Key
description: Keys ten and above on a character; key count 10 also makes the character a Soulmate.

effects: Kakera reactions on the character cost half power for the owner.
Each additional key grants +5% Kakera value.
Purple, Red, and Rainbow reactions give +75% Kakera on this character.
Purple, Red, and Rainbow reactions give +75% more Kakera (total +150%).
Purple, Red, and Rainbow reactions give +100% more Kakera (total +250%).
